summary: Psyence Biomedical, a Nasdaq-listed Canadian foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on September 14, 2026, disclosing via Exhibit 99.1 the formation of Texas Ibogaine Research Corporation, a wholly owned Texas vehicle intended to house U.S. ibogaine rights, supply, regulatory filings and potential clinical sponsorship. No price, stake, premium or transaction terms were stated. CEO Jody Aufrichtig also leads TIRC; Dr. John Thorne is project lead; CFO Warwick Corden-Lloyd holds oversight. This is an ordinary corporate/organizational update, not a special situation. Watch for definitive PsyLabs licensing terms and any IND filing.
